tools.name: search_jobs
tools.description: Search live job and internship listings in India, newest first. Filter by keywords (role, skill or company), city, and type. Returns up to 24 per page, each with a short description and a link.

tools.name: get_job
tools.description: Fetch one Indian listing in full: the complete description and how to apply (apply link, HR email or WhatsApp, whichever the employer gave). Takes the slug from search_jobs, or a carrerlift.in/jobs/ link.

tools.name: search_global_jobs
tools.description: Search internships and new-grad roles abroad (mostly USA, some international), merged from community job lists and refreshed a few times a day. Filter by keywords, level/region, and field.

tools.name: list_job_filters
tools.description: The cities and job types the Indian listings currently cover, busiest city first. Use to pick a valid location for search_jobs.

findings.title: Toxic flow: untrusted input can reach an external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: get_job · Public sink: get_job.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: get_job · Public sink: get_job

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
